Job Description IDP Prompt Engineer

Position Title

IDP Prompt Engineer




Reporting To

Product Manager, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP)

Role Purpose

The IDP Prompt Engineer is responsible for driving the successful adoption, optimization, and continuous improvement of Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) solutions across The role focuses on designing AI prompts, configuring document extraction logic, improving automation accuracy, and supporting the onboarding of new countries, customers, and business processes.

Working closely with Operations, Process Excellence, Product Owners, Business SMEs, and Technology Teams, the IDP Prompt Engineer will transform manual document processing activities into scalable, AI-driven automated workflows, improving productivity, data quality, and customer experience across GSC operations. This role leverages IDP platform capabilities such as prompt engineering, extraction rules, AI validation techniques, training models, and document automation frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

Intelligent Document Processing & Prompt Engineering

Design, develop, test, and optimize prompts to improve document extraction accuracy and automation performance.
Configure and maintain extraction rules, AI models, prompt libraries, and validation logic.
Develop and maintain reusable prompt standards and best practices across GSC.
Analyse document structures, business rules, and logistics workflows to improve AI performance.
Continuously refine prompts based on operational feedback and processing outcomes.

Business Process Automation

Support automation initiatives across Air Freight, Ocean Freight, Customs Brokerage, and Logistics Operations.
Partner with business stakeholders to identify and prioritize document automation opportunities.
Translate operational requirements into AI-driven document processing solutions.
Support onboarding of new business entities, countries, customers, and document types.

Solution Testing & Quality Management

Execute training, testing, and validation activities for new implementations and enhancements.
Investigate extraction issues and perform root-cause analysis.
Monitor automation accuracy and recommend improvement actions.
Establish quality benchmarks and ensure adherence to service standards.

Platform Governance & Administration

Configure dictionaries, lookup tables, business rules, and validation mechanisms.
Maintain process documentation, user guides, and operational standards.
Support release testing, change management, and production deployments.
Ensure compliance with governance, security, and data quality standards.

Stakeholder Engagement

Collaborate with Operations, Product Teams, Process Owners, and Technology Teams globally.
Conduct user training, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Provide subject matter expertise on intelligent automation and document processing capabilities.
Support transition-to-operations and hypercare activities following deployments.

Education & Experience

Education

Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Analytics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.

Experience

3+ years of experience in:
Intelligent Document Processing (IDP)
Artificial Intelligence or Machine Learning solutions
OCR and document capture technologies
Process Automation
Shared Services or Logistics Operations

Preferred Experience

DHL Global Forwarding operational processes.
Freight Forwarding and Customs documentation.
Rossum, ABBYY, Kofax, UiPath Document Understanding, Microsoft AI Builder, or similar IDP platforms.
Generative AI and Prompt Engineering.

Technical Competencies

Mandatory

Prompt Engineering
Generative AI & Large Language Models (LLMs)
Intelligent Document Processing (IDP)
OCR Technologies
Data Validation & Quality Assurance
Process Analysis and Improvement
Microsoft 365 Suite
Business Rule Configuration

Preferred

Microsoft Copilot
Power Platform
Power Automate
Power BI
SQL
Python
API Integration Fundamentals
AI Model Testing & Optimization

Functional Knowledge

Freight Forwarding Operations
Air Freight Documentation
Ocean Freight Documentation
Customs Documentation
Commercial Invoices
Packing Lists
Shipping Instructions
Bills of Lading
House Airway Bills
Shipment Processing Workflows

Key Competencies

Analytical Thinking
Problem Solving
Attention to Detail
Customer Focus
Stakeholder Management
Innovation & Digital Mindset
Continuous Improvement
Communication & Presentation Skills
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Change Management

Performance Measures

95% Document Extraction Accuracy
Reduction in Manual Processing Effort
Automation Benefit Realization
Production Defect Reduction
Successful Customer/Country Onboarding
User Adoption and Satisfaction
Prompt Reusability and Standardization
Productivity Improvements Delivered

Career Path

IDP Prompt Engineer Senior IDP Prompt Engineer Intelligent Automation Consultant Product Owner (IDP) Digital Solutions Manager Head of Automation & Digital Solutions

Executive Role Summary

The IDP Prompt Engineer plays a key role in digital transformation journey by leveraging Intelligent Document Processing and Generative AI technologies to automate document-intensive business processes, improve operational efficiency, enhance data quality, and accelerate the adoption of intelligent automation across global shared service operations.
